## Problem
SolarSPELL needed a reproducible pipeline to prepare field survey results for analysis.

## Data
Collected responses from multiple countries with varying schemas and encodings.

## Approach
- Normalized column names and coded categorical values
- Loaded cleaned tables into MySQL using SQLAlchemy
- Produced summary dashboards to explore regional trends

## Results
Delivered a reusable ETL script and database that cut data prep time in half.

## Top Themes from Open-Ended Responses

![Bar chart of the five most common themes explaining usefulness. “Resource availability” dominates, followed by affordability of technology, cost of books, cost of educational resources, and variety of tools.](../images/solarspell2.png){fig-cap="read_title"}

## Health-Related Searches in Lesotho

![Horizontal bar chart of search terms matched on SolarSPELL devices. “Cholera” overwhelms other topics (≈934 queries), ahead of generic “disease” (~94), “heart” (~47), “ill” (~41), “diabetes” (~36), and “hand washing” (~34), indicating content demand and potential outreach priorities.](../images/solarspell3.png){fig-cap="read_title"}

## CA Plots: Productivity Lift for Users

![Slide showing boxplots for Conservation Agriculture (CA) plots. SolarSPELL users have higher and more consistent yields, with median productivity ~49.15 Kg/Are vs ~45.00 Kg/Are for non-users.](../images/solarspell4.png){fig-cap="read_title"}

## SP Plots: Consistent Gains Across Methods

![Standard Practice (SP) plots show the same pattern: users’ median productivity ~38.00 Kg/Are vs ~30.46 Kg/Are for non-users. The note highlights similar gains observed for other crops grown with CA, reinforcing broad utility.](../images/solarspell5.png){fig-cap="read_title"}

## Knowledge Sharing: More Farmers Training Others

![Simple bar chart comparing the share of farmers who trained peers. SolarSPELL users are more likely to teach others—~82% vs ~77% among non-users—underscoring community diffusion effects.](../images/solarspell6.png){fig-cap="read_title"}

## The “Wow” Stat: Amplified Community Impact

![Users train far more people on average (≈103 individuals per farmer) than non-users (≈42). The slide frames this as ROI and scalability: each user becomes a local knowledge hub.](../images/solarspell7.png){fig-cap="read_title"}
